title: Front page lands on today's actual date

history.detail:
PASS: QA1 gate-1 audit, Sprint 44, commit 34eebd2 (main HEAD). Verdict: PASS.

Sprint file: re-read fresh. It is unchanged since Dev Team 1's start (d7fc413) apart from the lifecycle status line. Its dependency (Sprint 41 resolved first) is satisfied: Sprint 41 was closed in c9c01d9, before this build.

Handoff: read at 34eebd2 with git show. It has a Round 1 section quoting VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0 with 40 files and 486 tests. QA1's own npm run verify at 34eebd2 (clean tree): verify=0, 40 files, 486 tests, and the route table shows "ƒ /". The test count is consistent: 510 minus 19 front-door tests minus 6 wikipedia tests, with page.test.ts rewritten.

Approach: Dev Team restored Sprint 41's files from d638916, the commit just before 0aad17a. QA1 confirmed:
- git diff d638916 34eebd2 -- README.md lib/events is empty, so both are byte-identical to pre-41;
- git log d638916..34eebd2 on those paths shows only 0aad17a and 34eebd2, so the checkout reverted no one else's change, and Sprint 40's README work (pre-d638916) is intact.

R1: met. app/page.tsx is await connection(); redirect(datePagePath(utcToday())). It is a server component redirect, so 307. ƒ / is in QA1's own build. The handoff's live evidence shows 307 to /date/2026-11-24 with no-store and no age header.

R2: met. The import closure of / is:
- app/page.tsx imports next/navigation, next/server and lib/date-page/params;
- params imports ephemeris/adapter;
- adapter imports astronomy-engine and ./zodiac.
There is no Wikipedia module and no Supabase. page.test.ts asserts fetch is never called.

R3: met. front-door.ts and its test are deleted. fetchDayEventYears is removed. grep of frontDoorDate, front-door, fetchDayEventYears, entryMatchesDateYear and feedMonthDay in app and lib finds nothing (exit 1).
- Dev Team's choice, stated in the handoff: entryMatchesDateYear and feedMonthDay are also removed, which the sprint allowed.
- fetchDayEvents and its tests are byte-identical to pre-41. Sprint 41 only appended to wikipedia.test.ts, so the fetchDayEvents tests are the same text before, during and after 41. Both its behaviour and its tests are unchanged.

R4: met. The page.tsx header is Sprint 28's comment, plus one sentence: Sprint 44 confirmed it as the user's decision, and / makes no outbound call. There is no latest-year mention.

R5: met. The route list says "/ redirects (307) to /date/<today, UTC>", and Local setup's paragraph says the same. Both are pre-41 text, which matches the behaviour.

R6: met, see Handoff.

Tests: page.test.ts covers connection before redirect, the UTC midnight boundary (23:59:59.999Z to 00:00Z moves the day on) and no fetch. They're meaningful for a two-line page.

No defects, no questions from Dev Team, no Human Prerequisites. LiveQA step 3 (Sprint 39's message on today's page) is expected behaviour per the sprint file.
